Method of Attack: Crafting a request to web services within the Exchange Control Panel (ECP) application to steal messages from a victim’s inbox
Exploiting delegation confusion to access configuration options of user mailboxes and define email forwarding rules
Using a non-empty 'SecurityToken' cookie to bypass authentication due to missing DelegatedAuthModule on backend ECP site
Obtaining an 'ECP canary' ticket by triggering an HTTP 500 error to issue unauthenticated requests
Discoverer: Information Security Center of Vietnam Posts and Telecommunications Group (VNPT-ISC)
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated HTTP requests to Exchange Control Panel (ECP) web services
Exploitation of Delegated Authentication feature misconfiguration
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of 'SecurityToken' cookie in requests within '/ecp'
HTTP 500 error containing valid string for 'ECP canary' ticket
Requests to /ecp page without ticket triggering HTTP 500 error
